newsitem.title: USA: Northwest to increase fall Pacific freighters.
newsitem.headline: Northwest to increase fall Pacific freighters.

text.p: Northwest Airlines is squeezing more transpacific frequencies from its eight Boeing 747-200 freighters this fall by cutting out some domestic stops on flights currently serving more than one U.S. gateway, the carrier said.
The airline said in a statement the new schedule introduces a Wednesday Tokyo-New York flight, also one extra flight from Tokyo to San Francisco and another extra flight to Los Angeles.
The number of flights from Osaka to the U.S. will double to four, the carrier said.

The reduction in U.S. points per routing will not only result in increased transpacific rotations, the carrier said, it will improve the mechanical reliability and on-time performance of the 747 fleet by reducing the number of takeoffs and landings they make. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
